//ConnectionStrings: LocalDB needs Encrypt=False: it has no server certificate, so an encrypted handshake fails before SQL can be reached and every request dies as HTTP 500 with 'CanConnectAsync returned false'. This key is Development-only, which is also the only environment Program.cs:41 lets carry Encrypt=False - a Production or Staging host must supply a real string through the environment or secret store. Note that user-secrets outrank this file, so a stale 'dotnet user-secrets set ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection' left over from a hosted rehearsal silently wins here and points the local run at a server the laptop cannot reach.
//Bootstrap: DemoUsers is the second of two switches DemoUserSeeder needs: the host must also be running in the Development environment. It adds one signable-in account per role so every dashboard can be opened without first approving seven self-registered accounts. Set it to false - or delete this block - and no such account is ever created, on any machine. The accounts and their passwords are listed in README.md and are for this local database only.
